page.notes: The letters "Chonia" carry a small mark above the C of "Chonia" (possibly a stray dot or damage); read as "Chonia". "confícta" has an accent-like mark over the i; reading uncertain, marked [?]. The page ends mid-word with "septen-"; the continuation is on the next page. Long s and ligatures normalised to plain s; spelling otherwise as printed.
